name: Adoni-Bezek
bio: Adoni-Bezek was the Canaanite king of Bezek. After Joshua's death, the tribes of Judah and Simeon went to war against the Canaanites, killing ten thousand men at Bezek and capturing Adoni-Bezek, cutting off his thumbs and big toes. Adoni-Bezek said, "Seventy kings with their thumbs and big toes cut off have picked up scraps under my table. Now God has paid me back for what I did to them." The Israelites brought him to Jerusalem, where he died (Judges 1:4-7). His own self-aware remark at the end of his life stands as a vivid biblical example of reaping exactly what one has sown.
